search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1649904 (Rhythm Pharmaceuticals) via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent plus older 'files' pages); fetched the exhibits of every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2020-12 to 2026-09.

Rows read from the 'Product revenue, net' line of the condensed consolidated statements of operations in each quarterly earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1); the quarter is the one ended before the filing date and is confirmed by the prior-year comparative column. 2021Q1 (35 thousand) is the first quarter with product revenue: the 2022Q1 release prints its prior-year column as 35 and the 2021Q1 release prints 2020Q1 as a dash.
Prior-year check: the prior-year comparative column of 18 quarterly quotes equals the figure recorded for that earlier quarter from its own filing.
